alt: A short film with no voice. A pink dining room with a long dark table and three chairs. Two small block figures with white eyes sit at the two ends, an ink-black one on the left and a cobalt blue one on the right, and each has a plate. They take turns leaning in and pushing small flat shapes (a yellow square, a blue circle, an orange triangle, a white diamond, a light blue drop, a red square) to the middle of the table until it is full. The third chair, behind the table, stays empty. Both figures lean toward each other with happy eyes. The text stays on screen: if you're seeing this, say thanks out loud to someone at your table.
